subject: FinTechCo MAP draft — target close & procurement signature deadline

Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: FinTechCo MAP draft — proposed milestones and target close

Hi Evelyn —

Great to meet yesterday. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures milestones, owners, and suggested dates based on our discovery:

High-level target: 30-day pilot contract and go-live for evaluation workloads.

Proposed milestones (draft):
- 02/26: Finalize scope of pilot (owner: FinTechCo)
- 03/05: Security & compliance review (owner: Redwood + FinTechCo Sec)
- 03/10: Tech SPOC integration (SSO/KMS) — dev kickoff (owner: Redwood SE)
- 03/18: Pilot readiness & smoke tests (owner: FinTechCo/SRE)
- 03/26: Target close (contract signed / purchase order)
- 03/30: Procurement signature deadline (hard deadline requested by FinTechCo)

Dependencies we flagged on the call: SOC2 evidence for data handling, KMS/SSO configuration windows, and procurement lead times for PO issuance.

Next steps from our side: we will produce MAP v1 with assigned owners and upload to Drive. Can you confirm the target close date (03/26) and procurement signature deadline (03/30) are realistic for your internal process? If procurement needs an earlier deadline, tell us and we will re-align milestones.

Attachments: FinTechCo_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/fintechco/FinTechCo_MAP_Draft_v1

Thanks — happy to set a 15-min follow-up with procurement if that helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinTechCo MAP draft — proposed milestones and target close

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the quick turnaround and clear MAP. A couple of notes from my side after a quick check with procurement and legal: 

1) Procurement needs the contract signed by 03/30 at the latest; however, because of an internal Q2 freeze we should aim to have the commercial sign-off and PO ready by 03/26 to give procurement time to process. So your proposed 03/26 target close makes sense but 03/30 is the absolute legal signature deadline.

2) Can you call out any contractual redlines up front (e.g., data residency, indemnity caps)? Legal asked for a short list so they can triage. Also confirm whether SSO and KMS setup are part of the pilot scope or post-signature.

I will loop in our procurement contact, Carlos Vega, for scheduling and PO/questions — copying him once I pull his calendar.

Evelyn
Head of Integrations | FinTechCo
evelyn.martin@fintechco.com

Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinTechCo MAP draft — updated MAP v2 + redlines summary

Evelyn —

Thanks for the quick feedback. I updated the MAP and added an explicit "contract checklist" section that calls out the common redlines and whether we can accept them in standard form. See key points below (full details in MAP v2 attached):

Contract/redlines summary:
- Data residency: Redwood supports US and EU regional deployments; for pilot we will use US region unless you require EU.
- Indemnity/limits: Redwood requests mutual indemnity with standard commercial caps; any proposed changes should be flagged by legal.
- Data retention/exports: We can provide export and deletion processes during pilot; production retention policies can be negotiated post-pilot.

Pilot scope & SSO/KMS:
- SSO (OIDC) and KMS integration are scoped into the pilot to validate end-to-end flow, but any KMS HSM integration for production will be post-signature. For pilot we can provide a sandbox KMS and support config.

Revised milestone table (owners + dates):
- 02/26: Finalize pilot scope (FinTechCo)
- 03/05: Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence (Redwood + FinTechCo Sec)
- 03/10: SE integration kickoff (Redwood SE - Nikhil)
- 03/18: Pilot readiness | smoke tests (FinTechCo/SRE)
- 03/26: Commercial sign-off / exec approval (FinTechCo) -> target close
- 03/30: Procurement signature (Carlos Vega / FinTechCo) -> legal signature deadline

Dependencies:
- SOC2 artifact delivery (Redwood to upload by 03/03)
- PO issuance window: FinTechCo procurement to confirm cut-off for PO creation
- Legal redline turnaround (FinTechCo legal)

Attachments: FinTechCo_MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/fintechco/FinTechCo_MAP_Draft_v2
DocuSign placeholder: https://app.docusign.com/fintechco/placeholder

If that aligns, can we lock in a 30-minute procurement sync next week? Proposed times: Tue 03/02 10:00-10:30 or Wed 03/03 14:00-14:30 PT. I can send a calendar invite once you confirm who from procurement will join.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: Re: FinTechCo MAP draft — updated MAP v2 + redlines summary

Marissa —

This looks good. I pulled procurement into the thread — Carlos Vega (copied) is our procurement lead and will drive PO timing. Carlos, can you confirm whether 03/30 is a hard legal cut-off for signatures and whether we can process the PO by 03/26 if necessary?

We will target commercial sign-off by 03/26 and aim to have procurement signature by 03/30. If procurement needs more info (e.g., MSA redlines, insurance certs), Carlos, please call that out and we will prioritize.

Carlos, I can make Tue 03/02 10:00 PT, but if your calendar is full the Wed slot also works.

Thanks — looking forward to the procurement sync.
